FN-ZQ98GRR-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 59
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Kerry Underwood
Commissions
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/12/2026
REVISED
House Bill 59 as introduced would reduce the expenses of the State Board of Public
Accountancy by approximately $5,000 for any change in the administrative rules for
professional conduct proposed by the board by allowing the board to email such change to
registered public accountants, instead of sending notice by mail, as provided by current law.
This bill could further reduce the expenses of the board by an undetermined amount dependent
on any savings from allowing the board to send notice of charges issued by the board by email,
instead of sending notice by mail, as provided by current law.
Page 1
